original_card.question: Can the 64-per-call centre path (eight rank-8 COPY/ERASE totals through the private temporary) be shared across calls or shrunk?
methods: Derive a fully charged favorable relaxation for sharing one centre path across k calls, including restoration, hosting and precision.
Prove a lower bound on copied information per call for the selected decoder contract.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Show the changed centre charge and copy profile per call with every added restoration or hosting cost charged, and its ceiling via ceiling.ceiling(centre=...). A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write the per-call centre charge and copy children for sharing across k = 2 calls, charge the sharing overhead, and screen it; stop this route if even the ideal sharing gains under 10%. Ideal budgets: free 2.80x, shared by two 1.90x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The centre path consumes 64 of about 99.6 unpaid coordinates per call, i.e. about 64% of the raw deficit.
allowed_variations: One sharing pattern across a fixed number of calls.
One reduced copied-total contract for the existing decoder.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Removing copies without a replacement contract for the decoder's copied totals.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: p=19 uncoded controller word: emitted as the controller's own gate trace and certified by a trace identity plus the p=19 diagonalisation, then priced by the code-blind invoice at 0.007578535 against the admitted BIT supplier 0.0034. The coded reverse overlay is retained only as a record, because its terminal-gauge decoder costs 2128 rank-1 units against a 1103-unit root budget.
scope_change_reason: Audits of the coded draft (PR #5349 and the reviews on PR #5270) showed that the physical reverse call's letter is D, not the R that commutes with the code, so every coded word needs a Q-conjugated terminal gauge; no proper subset of coded pairs diagonalises (checked at p=3,4,5) and the decoder exceeds the invoice's root budget. Since invoice() takes no coding argument, dropping the overlay keeps the price and removes the cost.
bottleneck_link: The complex side is not binding: the p=19 word prices at 0.007578535 against a frontier of 0.00302015, so the endpoint is the admitted BIT saving 0.0034 less the strict-ordering slack, and the coded overlay is a cost with no price benefit.
stop_rule: Stop after the materialized word, the paid accounting and the claim receipt; do not touch the selected frontier, the compiler interfaces or other packages.
evidence: PASS word: 259 gate records (19 gauge loads, 19 unloads, 19 reverse adds, 19 letters, 36 retained idles, 20 forwards, 108 bridges, 19 closing swaps), 77 recodings, replay equals the standard word on 0 of 229376 entries at p=2 and 0 of 2179072 at p=19 (dense), with the gauge invariant holding after every gate. PASS code: A = I - MM^T/4, A^-1 = I + (A - I)/13 = I - MM^T/52, A A^-1 = I exact, prefix bounds 57 and 69/13, no recursive Gaussian child. PASS invoice: rank-free code; tested saving on the source grid as kappa + 7*gap with gap = 1/1400000000; raw moment sign positive in exact interval arithmetic and in a 60-digit decimal engine, positive a step below and negative above the root; ratios at kappa alpha 0.99579414, gamma 0.963763, delta 0.951561. PASS bill: 17248 monomial field maps, 68992 scalar adds, 1232 owned clears per call, zero Gaussian rank. PASS compiler: the shape-correct majorant from query-thinned-controllers::tail (h = 1/64, B = (5+8h)v, H0 >= 8v; premises 20^64 < 21^63 and 153 < 256) gives H0 = 5170423668736 and H1 = 49222448837637726209 with the previous threshold rejected; the p7 constants of power_majorant_comparison do not apply (20 < 2^4, 153 < 2^7 and 20^7 < 21^6 all false) and the logarithmic majorant caps the tested saving at 611329/200000000. PASS BIT: atom 0.004 > ordinary 0.0034363538 > admitted 0.0034. PASS ledger: passes at kappa = 951999/280000000 and at exactly 0.0034 only actual_bit_above_effective fails. OPEN: the terminal-gauge decoder (one Q per owner per thick stage = 2128 rank-1 units against a 1103-unit root budget, 1103/1204 computed here) and the word/controller binding reported in #5349.
